# Colophon {-}

Written in R Markdown and built with **bookdown** [@R-bookdown]. Typeset in
Inter and JetBrains Mono. Figures use the viridis plasma palette (option `"C"`),
the series convention for this volume.

```{r colophon-session, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
sessioninfo::session_info(pkgs = "attached")
```
